purpose: Finite adversarial coverage plan, not all possible ECG inputs

evidence_levels.A: formal property or independent analytic reference for stated assumptions

severity.critical: may silently alter physical calibration, direction, clinically relevant content or validity of a superiority claim
severity.high: substantial geometry/content failure or unsupported output

acceptance_note: Engineering gates are not clinical acceptability thresholds. Evidence for one family does not cover all continuous parameters. Current evidence is deliberately descriptive until independent M4 executions are appended.

cases.family: Exact planar affine
cases.identifiability: Identifiable given correct pitch, IDs and orientation
cases.independent_truth: Closed-form nonsingular affine and independent queries
cases.acceptance_gate: Global candidate exact to declared numerical tolerance. No residual-induced bias. Roundtrip separately reported.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Exact affine/projective finite component controls only.

cases.family: Strong planar perspective
cases.identifiability: Identifiable with noncollinear correctly identified nodes and no crossing horizon
cases.independent_truth: Closed-form homography, held-out interiors and edges
cases.acceptance_gate: Projective exactness on clean plane, denominator same sign over full supported hull, no horizon crossing.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Clean planar homography evaluated at independent interior queries.

cases.family: Noisy plane and localization quantization
cases.identifiability: Statistical, conditional on correct correspondence and declared noise
cases.independent_truth: Independent latent coordinates before noise, independent noise seeds
cases.acceptance_gate: Retain global H and regularized candidates. Report tail loss and per-scene regressions. Selection cannot use latent truth.
cases.current_evidence: M3 local overfit reproduced, M4 pending

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Two plane noise levels retained. No noise distribution calibration.

cases.family: Smooth nonplanar developable sheet
cases.identifiability: Identifiable only where observation supplies adequate spatial constraints
cases.independent_truth: Independent camera projection of cylinder/cone and calibrated real sheet
cases.acceptance_gate: Evaluate interiors, interpolation bias and tails beyond fitted nodes. Analytic 2D distortion alone does not certify a developable physical sheet.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: M4 smooth maps are analytic2D proxies, not physical cylinder/cone or real-sheet evidence.

cases.family: Nondevelopable crumple, stretch or wet paper
cases.identifiability: Partly identifiable with dense visible grid, model class may be false
cases.independent_truth: Independent measured surface/camera or dense fiduciary metrology
cases.acceptance_gate: Mark unsupported model assumptions. No global H or developability certificate based solely on low fit residual.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: No nondevelopable real-sheet component study.

cases.family: Aligned visible crease
cases.identifiability: Piecewise identifiable if crease sides and nodes are observed
cases.independent_truth: Piecewise closed-form maps and independent 3D hinge
cases.acceptance_gate: C0 continuity, no fold or overlap, preserve crease instead of oversmoothing.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: One aligned analytic crease and all candidate negatives retained.

cases.family: Oblique/subcell crease
cases.identifiability: Underconstrained between sparse grid nodes
cases.independent_truth: Analytic oblique hinge with held-out crease-near queries
cases.acceptance_gate: Preserve negative controls and worst local error. Abstain from unsupported subcell certainty, no mean-only improvement.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Clean oblique crease worsens. Reported as retained failure, not passed accuracy gate.

cases.family: Hidden crease between identical boundary observations
cases.identifiability: Not identifiable from sparse matching nodes alone
cases.independent_truth: Two distinct maps with identical supplied node observations
cases.acceptance_gate: Expose model uncertainty or unsupported interval. Never certify physical error from perfect node fit.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Constructive identifiability witness only. General2D bump is not an unstretched-paper impossibility theorem.

cases.family: Missing central grid or erased printed grid
cases.identifiability: Geometry may interpolate under a declared prior, content can remain observed
cases.independent_truth: Known independent warp plus strokes/text in no-grid area
cases.acceptance_gate: No confidence mask on RGB. Separate observed/interpolated/extrapolated support. No silent bridge across unsupported holes.
cases.current_evidence: M3 gap evidence and actual sampler evidence

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Gap support and trust/RGB separation exercised separately. No full frontend no-grid-photo benchmark.

cases.family: Large unobserved margin/header
cases.identifiability: Extrapolation cannot be certified from grid alone
cases.independent_truth: Independent full-paper map plus margin annotations
cases.acceptance_gate: Return original and label extrapolation. Full-paper coverage and annotation loss assessed outside trusted grid.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Trust-free sampling and content policy tested. No independent full-paper extrapolation metrology.

cases.family: Disconnected lattice components
cases.identifiability: Each island origin/phase may be unidentifiable without shared cues
cases.independent_truth: Independent lattice IDs, paired ambiguous component observations
cases.acceptance_gate: Do not silently retain only largest component or independently origin-register islands. Export alternative associations.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Disconnected physical phase witness only. No new detector organization run.

cases.family: Every-other major line and major/minor pitch alias
cases.identifiability: Not identifiable if distinguishing printed cues are absent
cases.independent_truth: Observationally identical sparse lattice with 5 versus 10 mm interpretation
cases.acceptance_gate: Cross-validation and cycle consistency must not certify pitch. Declare unresolved scale or use an independent inference-time calibration cue.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Coherent pitch alias executed and passes numerical checks with W100%. This fails a physical certainty gate.

cases.family: Skipped/duplicated row, col or coherent ID band fault
cases.identifiability: Sometimes observable globally, locally coherent errors can imitate warp
cases.independent_truth: Independent canonical IDs and deliberately contaminated supplied IDs
cases.acceptance_gate: Retain catastrophic cases. Candidate selection without gold. ID uncertainty remains distinct from geometric fit.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Row/half-sheet observation faults executed. Full skipped/duplicated-ID decoder not implemented.

cases.family: D4 rotation and mirrored source
cases.identifiability: Bare square lattice is ambiguous, text/lead/calibration cues may identify
cases.independent_truth: Independent orientation manifest, asymmetric text/spike/lead windows
cases.acceptance_gate: Inference chooses orientation without gold. D4 oracle remains a diagnostic. Reflection must not silently change ECG polarity/time.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Bare-grid and symmetric-text ambiguity witnesses. No new native orientation frontend.

cases.family: Unknown absolute chart origin
cases.identifiability: Translation gauge unidentifiable without an anchor convention
cases.independent_truth: Known physical page/crop origin and separately identifiable cue
cases.acceptance_gate: One translation-only diagnostic allowed, native origin/timing/baseline separately reported. No per-component alignment.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Absolute-origin counterexample. Translation-gauge score would remove it, native origin remains unavailable.

cases.family: Photocopied anisotropic stretch or rectangular printed grid
cases.identifiability: Canonical scale needs device/print conventions or independently available cues
cases.independent_truth: Measured printed pitch and original signal metadata
cases.acceptance_gate: Do not enforce isotropic 5 mm prior when native paper convention is unverified. Preserve actual time/mV calibration.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Lattice equivalence witness, not photographed stretched-paper validation.

cases.family: Multiple grids, overlapping sheets, mixed panels or pasted strips
cases.identifiability: May admit several incompatible lattices
cases.independent_truth: Independent ownership mask and source-to-panel physical maps
cases.acceptance_gate: Never force one coordinate chart across competing sheets or lead strips. Explicit ambiguity/segmentation or abstention.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Mixed-unit chart constraint example only.

cases.family: Perspective horizon or near-singular camera view
cases.identifiability: Ill-conditioned or nonidentifiable at grazing limit
cases.independent_truth: Analytic denominator extrema on convex hull and degenerate controls
cases.acceptance_gate: Reject crossing horizon, near-zero area and unstable inverse. State tested numerical margin.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Independent collinear/horizon/degenerate controls.

cases.family: Folded or positive-area overlapping mesh
cases.identifiability: Image-to-material map may be multi-valued under occlusion
cases.independent_truth: Independent triangle intersections and preimage multiplicity
cases.acceptance_gate: Reject source/target positive-area overlaps, mixed orientations and ambiguous inverse. Positive Jacobian alone is insufficient.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Positive-area double-wrap and inverse controls, finite numerical examples only.

cases.family: Positive local Jacobians with global wrap
cases.identifiability: Locally valid does not imply one-to-one
cases.independent_truth: Explicit double-wrapped strip or non-simple boundary
cases.acceptance_gate: Simple boundary plus suitable topology theorem or explicit global overlap check required. Cycle on chosen branch is insufficient.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Independent single-wrap attack failed v1 and is rejected by guard-v2. No universal float topology theorem.

cases.family: Duplicated, collinear or noninteger node identifiers
cases.identifiability: Invalid assumptions are directly observable
cases.independent_truth: Hand-constructed degenerate inputs
cases.acceptance_gate: Reject explicitly and deterministically. No plausible finite map from malformed data.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Duplicate/noninteger IDs and collinear anchors explicitly rejected.

cases.family: Spatially coherent outliers and registration drift
cases.identifiability: Potentially indistinguishable from real deformation
cases.independent_truth: Independent clean map plus clustered perturbations
cases.acceptance_gate: Blocked heldout source observations excluded from both fits. Preserve worst-case wrong coverage and robust/global controls.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Random outliers and coherent faults retained, including complete rejection and severe wrong coverage.

cases.family: Opaque occlusion, finger or torn-away sheet
cases.identifiability: Hidden ECG content is not recoverable from the input alone
cases.independent_truth: Known occlusion layer and original visible support
cases.acceptance_gate: Exclude invisible material from visible-content truth, report occluded fraction separately. Do not hallucinate waveform.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Constructive visibility/occlusion witnesses, no recovery accuracy claim.

cases.family: Glare/clipping, severe blur, JPEG destruction or sub-Nyquist input
cases.identifiability: Lost source information is not invertibly recoverable
cases.independent_truth: Independent pre-capture signal, optical model and measured input
cases.acceptance_gate: Do not claim sampling can recover absent observations. Report information loss and abstention, retain source archive.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Observed-source sampling loss demonstrated. No new optical blur/JPEG/glare destruction study.

cases.family: Shadows, colored grid, grayscale, stains and dark background
cases.identifiability: May confound grid detector while ECG remains observed
cases.independent_truth: Matched geometry with independently varied photometry
cases.acceptance_gate: Geometry target unchanged by blur/photometry, signal retention by separate masks and native layouts.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: No new neural photometric robustness benchmark.

cases.family: Layout unsupported by comparator
cases.identifiability: Supported task known before predictions
cases.independent_truth: Official versioned task assumptions and pre-inference manifest
cases.acceptance_gate: All-layout operational table plus powered stated-support stratum. Never redefine support by success.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Compatible-task data design only, M3 N1 remains unchanged.

cases.family: Thin vertical strokes across phase
cases.identifiability: Input-observed stroke is identifiable, output sampling can lose it
cases.independent_truth: Exact affine coordinates, independent pixel-cell area reference
cases.acceptance_gate: Retain disappearance counts, contrast, signed and absolute dark-area error at fixed density. No mask-based RGB deletion.
cases.current_evidence: M3 actual loss and integration candidate

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Finite strip sampling controls, including32:1 disappearance and restricted exact-area repair.

cases.family: Oblique and horizontal thin strokes/spikes
cases.identifiability: Observable only up to input bandwidth
cases.independent_truth: Exact strips, impulses and independently rasterized line intersections
cases.acceptance_gate: Report all angles/phases, isolated narrow pacer spikes and broad calibration pulses separately. No finite quadrature universal guarantee.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Archived analytical strip angles and finite line family. No actual clinical pacing-spike endpoint.

cases.family: Tiny text, decimal points, lead labels and annotations
cases.identifiability: Text semantics can fail despite low full-image MAE
cases.independent_truth: Source-annotated glyph/point masks plus exact geometric reference
cases.acceptance_gate: Object-wise survival and legibility assessment, no full-paper average to hide tiny missing objects.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: No source-annotated text/decimal/lead-label preservation assessment.

cases.family: Anisotropic/sheared minification
cases.identifiability: Identifiable under correct inverse
cases.independent_truth: Exact affine matrix and analytic output footprints
cases.acceptance_gate: Compare effective directional pixel scale and aliasing. Report footprint integration and source reconstruction model.
cases.current_evidence: M3 affine anisotropy positive, M4 pending

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Affine anisotropy/shear parity tested. Exact area route rejects shear/rotation.

cases.family: Nonlinear inverse with high curvature inside pixel
cases.identifiability: Approximation needs a resolution/error bound
cases.independent_truth: Closed-form smooth inverse plus independent high-order or exact integral
cases.acceptance_gate: Area quadrature refinement and explicit unresolved error. Agreement of finite 2/4/8 grids is not a universal guarantee.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Nonlinear map tile invariance only. No independently bounded nonlinear-footprint integral accuracy.

cases.family: Border pixel, half-open footprint and partial source support
cases.identifiability: Policy is identifiable and must be explicit
cases.independent_truth: Exact constant/edge impulse with analytic valid fraction
cases.acceptance_gate: Return finite/inside/reconstruction fractions separately. Explicit background or normalization policy, no hidden edge-renormalization.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Half-open source cells, partial support, fill and fractions tested.

cases.family: NaN, Inf, overflow, rejected or ambiguous inverse samples
cases.identifiability: Invalidity directly observable
cases.independent_truth: Hand-constructed invalid inverse results
cases.acceptance_gate: Invalid sample contributes declared background and never samples safe technical coordinate zero. No dropping from denominator.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Nonfinite/extreme maps forced to fill without borrowing source origin.

cases.family: RGB confidence zero over observed content
cases.identifiability: Confidence is not evidence that RGB pixels are absent
cases.independent_truth: Same RGB/map with trust false, true and mixed masks
cases.acceptance_gate: Decoded RGB exactly independent of trust. Trust exported separately including zero/full support.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: RGB/RGBA bytes exactly unchanged under false/true/mixed trust.

cases.family: RGBA transparent colored pixels and premultiplication
cases.identifiability: Alpha semantics explicitly declared
cases.independent_truth: Known RGBA mixtures with analytic premultiplied expected color
cases.acceptance_gate: No hidden-color fringe, alpha independent of geometric trust, unsupported channels fail explicitly.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Premultiplied alpha and transparent hidden color tested against independent references.

cases.family: Constant image, checkerboard, energy and dynamic range
cases.identifiability: Constants and bounds analytically known
cases.independent_truth: Exact constants and piecewise constant cells
cases.acceptance_gate: Constants preserved on fully supported footprint, output bounded, signed bias retained. Dark-area/MAE objectives reported separately.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Constants, bounds and finite reconstruction objectives tested. Not arbitrary-frequency sufficiency.

cases.family: Tile boundary and tile-size metamorphism
cases.identifiability: Exact algorithm should be tile invariant
cases.independent_truth: Same callable, source and grid partitioned in many tile sizes
cases.acceptance_gate: Bit-exact pixels and fraction arrays, query order documented, tile bounds enforced. No full-frame coordinate cache.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Finite tile partitions produce identical images/fractions in exercised cases.

cases.family: Huge output and bounded memory
cases.identifiability: Allocation behavior observable at declared shape/order
cases.independent_truth: Streaming consumer hash with isolated peak-RSS measurement
cases.acceptance_gate: Memory scales with tile size plus source/output contract, not Noutput times subgrid squared. Record unavoidable final image separately.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Owned coordinate batches bounded.8x1024x768 cost audited.16M frame figure is a formula, not execution.

cases.family: Encoder interruption, disk/replace error and truncated PNG
cases.identifiability: File validity directly testable
cases.independent_truth: Existing valid target plus injected failure and full pixel decode
cases.acceptance_gate: Temp on destination filesystem, full decode before replace. Old target retained on precommit failure, cleanup and commit state explicit.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Injected encoder, corrupt temporary and replace failures preserve prior valid target.

cases.family: Wrong mode/shape, dishonest metadata or stale resume
cases.identifiability: Artifact contract independently testable
cases.independent_truth: Pixel array hash, decoded bytes, source/config/receipt identities
cases.acceptance_gate: Reject mismatch, no dimensions-only validation. Resume binds source, config and output hash.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: PNG mode/shape/pixels/hashes verified. New full-pipeline stale-resume behavior not executed.

cases.family: Renderer-specific detector training advantage
cases.identifiability: Cannot be eliminated by adding more same-renderer synthetic cases
cases.independent_truth: New external renderers and real capture devices/patients never used for training/selection
cases.acceptance_gate: Separate native endpoint from matched-observation solver lane. Report known/unknown training overlap and unseen renderer/device strata.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: No new external renderer/device/patient endpoint data. Training-family advantage unresolved.

cases.family: Repeated patients, layouts and correlated comparator presets
cases.identifiability: Dependence observable from provenance
cases.independent_truth: Patient/source identity and paired capture hierarchy
cases.acceptance_gate: Cluster at patient/original-record level, no query-level pseudo-replication. Presets not independent methods.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: M4 has no patient-level endpoint cohort. Existing M3 descriptive clusters stay separate.

cases.family: Gold-selected candidate, scale or orientation rescue
cases.identifiability: Detectable by inference signature and perturbation controls
cases.independent_truth: Sealed truth and arbitrary gold permutation
cases.acceptance_gate: No gold input to selection, no winner per image from scored loss. Freeze config before assessment, record all candidates and failures.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Interface/source reviewed and input-only sealed decisions independently recomputed. Not arbitrary code noninterference proof.

cases.family: Conditional-risk or mean-score hiding content loss
cases.identifiability: Mask and averaging policies directly observable
cases.independent_truth: Fixed full-paper, material-area, grid and object-wise reference domains
cases.acceptance_gate: G/W/C/R together, abstention retained, tails/max/patient failures plus tiny-object recall. No single mean declares winner.
cases.current_evidence: M3 coverage separation, no text/waveform endpoint

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: All scene negatives and coverage retained. No tiny-text/common-waveform endpoint.

cases.family: Commercial product unavailable or patent-inspired proxy
cases.identifiability: Product access and exported fields are externally constrained
cases.independent_truth: Authorized documented product invocation and native output evidence
cases.acceptance_gate: Unavailable is N/A. Primitive resemblance never labelled Dotter/Gridder product score.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: No authorized commercial product invocation.

cases.family: Post-score protocol edits and reused holdout
cases.identifiability: Provenance observable
cases.independent_truth: Immutable manifest/code/weights/query hashes and event timestamps
cases.acceptance_gate: Version changes as development, never relabel consumed data fresh. New assessment after tuning.
cases.current_evidence: M3 already inspected, M4 analytical development

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Original defect/source retained and same-candidate guard repair versioned. M4 is development.

cases.family: Timing scopes, warm caches, shared CPU and hidden allocations
cases.identifiability: Measured only under named environment
cases.independent_truth: Cold/warm separated isolated runner and complete cost scopes
cases.acceptance_gate: Include load/prep/map/sample/export separately and end-to-end, RSS and thread counts. No CPU-to-GPU extrapolation.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: Named CPU cost scope and medians audited. No independent RSS remeasurement, cold NN or GPU run.

cases.family: Unknown waveform/lead/time calibration after rectification
cases.identifiability: Full endpoint needs independent supplied signal and native metadata
cases.independent_truth: Exact original mV waveform, lead ownership, sample-time windows and calibration pulses
cases.acceptance_gate: Common fixed extractor paired across rectifiers plus native pipeline separately. Geometry alone cannot certify clinical fidelity.

M4_review.scope_and_remaining_gap: No common waveform extractor or real clinical fidelity assessment.

M4_execution_summary.interpretation: A family is not exhausted by a finite test. Negative counterexamples count as executed, not as successful correction. Reviewed constructive witnesses are not independent QA reruns.
